operating_notes.text: Commenced trial run traffic operations on ₹6,538 Cr Ganga Expressway Group 1 (129.7 Kms Meerut-Budaun corridor) with tolling to start soon.
Commenced tolling at IRB Chandibhadra Tollway (TOT 18).
Reported April 2026 gross toll revenue of ₹793 Cr, up 23.6% YoY.
IRB Infrastructure Trust offered two BOT assets (Solapur Yedeshi NH211 and Chittorgarh Gulabpura NH79) with Enterprise Value of ₹4,663 Cr to IRB InvIT Fund.

Board approved continuing as Project Manager for O&M services to IRB Jaipur Deoli Tollway, IRB Pathankot Amritsar Toll Road, and IRB Talegaon Amravati Tollway from April 1, 2030 for ₹1,136 Cr (₹1,340 Cr with GST).
Meerut Budaun Expressway Limited commenced toll collection on the Ganga Expressway (Group 1) Project.
Board approved in-principle material related-party O&M arrangements for 12 SPVs of IRB Infrastructure Trust worth up to ₹23,012.24 Cr including GST.
Group FY26 Toll Revenue reported at ₹8,323 Cr, representing 10% of India's aggregate toll revenue.
May 2026 toll revenue reported at ₹843 Cr (₹8,427 Mn), up 25% YoY.

timeline.summary: IRB Infra Trust commissioned the ₹6,538 Cr Ganga Expressway Group 1 project, commencing trial traffic operations.
IRB Infra reported April 2026 gross toll collections of ₹793 Cr, up 24% YoY.
IRB Infrastructure Trust issued a non-binding offer to sell two BOT highway assets (EV ₹4,663 Cr) to IRB InvIT Fund.
IRB Infrastructure Developers approved agreements to continue acting as Project Manager and O&M provider for three SPVs of IRB InvIT Fund for ₹1,340 Cr including GST starting April 2030.
Meerut Budaun Expressway Limited commenced toll collection on the Ganga Expressway (Group 1) project on May 17, 2026.
IRB Infrastructure Developers announced it will release Q4 and FY26 results on May 20, 2026, and host an earnings call on May 21, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,927 Cr (-10.3% YoY), net profit ₹296.26 Cr (+38.0% YoY).

IRB Infrastructure Developers Limited shared the audio recording of its Q4FY26 earnings call on May 21, 2026, signed by **Mehul Kumar Patel** and **Natwarlal Patel** via **DigitallyMehulkumarsigned by r Natwarlal**.
Sudha D. Mhaiskar (Promoter Group Director) declared no new encumbrances on IRB Infrastructure Developers Limited shares in FY2025-26 beyond prior disclosures.
IRB Infrastructure Developers reported a 25% YoY increase in May 2026 gross toll collection to ₹843 Cr.

Mr. Virendra D. Mhaiskar, Mrs. Deepali V. Mhaiskar, Virendra D. Mhaiskar HUF, IRB Holding Private Limited, and Mr. Aryan V. Mhaiskar declared no new encumbrances on IRB Infrastructure Developers’ shares as of March 31, 2026.
